data.current_description:
Finds an existing deal and updates it if found, or creates it if not.

Lookup priority:
  1. `policy_number`
  2. `company_id` or resolved company from `insured_name` + `title`
  3. `contact_id` or resolved contact from `insured_name` + `title`
  4. `title` alone

`contact_id` may be a contact UUID or an email address. When updating a
matching record, only explicitly supplied fields are changed. On update,
`custom_fields` are merged with the existing object.

The `contact_id` parameter accepts either a contact UUID or email address. When updating a matching record, only explicitly supplied fields are modified, and custom_fields are merged with existing values. Returns the deal object with a 200 status code if updated, or 201 if created.
